Bicycle Wrap By Vinyl Wrap Toronto

This bicycle wrap was carefully wrapped in all the corners and a clean job was done. Are you a bike enthusiast or competing locally or nationally? We can add custom decals or stickers to your ride. This bicycle was wrapped for a TV commercial. We at Vinyl Wrap Toronto, take your enthusiasm and ideas and create the design to suit your desires.

Check out below the pictures of the work we did on the bike. We took the client’s ideas and made them a reality.
Our installation crew has 20 years of experience in the wrapping industry.
